page.layout: Full-width top verse of four italic lines, then a rule; a centred title block in roman and capitals; then one block of italic verse below with a large drop cap at its start. No margin notes. Printed page number and running head at the top right.

p.i: Illa quod tandem deterfa arugine, quantam Heu nimium multi intulerant, aniqueʃ Vetustas, Serrani ingenio niteas magnoque labore. Nos igitur tibi multa, Plato, debemus: at ipsum Debemus, fateor, tibi nos, Serrane, Platonem.

main_text.head: In DIOSCORIDEM Anabarzæum, à CL.V. & Medicinæ, Doctore præstantissimo IOHANNE ANTONIO SARACENO, post aliorum doctissimorum virorum emendationes diligentissimè, & feliciissimè restitutum.

p.i: NVminus imperio Verbum genitale locuti, Platarû qua prima tulit miracula Tellus, Quàm placitura oculis, tam minus [illegible, ~5 letters] apta, Eft mirata simul, simul eft scrutata Vetustas. Hoc raptus studio sapientum maximus ille Iesiades Solomon, a summis orsus, ad imas, Plantarum historiam chartis mandarat Hebraïs, Qua nobis si falsa foret, satis esset abunde, Quantùm vis avidas quod pascere undique metes. Illa licet Vero periit, res tanta iacere Attamè haud quaqua potuit, neque [illegible, ~4 letters] videri. Immo perfinuit non solis nota Sophorum Porticibus, Verum populis immanibus ipsis, Illorumque ipsis populorum regibus olim, Hæc sive Vtilitas fuafit, sive ipsa Venustas,

page.notes: The Greek words in the verse are too damaged to read reliably and are marked as illegible. Several Latin words are doubtful: "aniqueʃ", "Platarû", "Vero", "Sana Sideri" and "Hebraïs" are copied as printed. The page number is partly unclear. The initial drop cap is read as N followed by V and marked uncertain.
